def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Find full solid-color separator rows and columns.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if row[0] != 0 and all(v == row[0] for v in row)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if grid[0][c] != 0 and all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    tiles = [(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1], col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1])
             for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1) for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1)]
    # Use the tile with the most nonzero cells as the motif, then repeat it.
    sr, er, sc, ec = max(tiles, key=lambda b: sum(grid[r][c] != 0 for r in range(b[0], b[1]) for c in range(b[2], b[3])))
    motif = [grid[r][sc:ec] for r in range(sr, er)]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1, c0, c1 in tiles:
        if r1-r0 != len(motif) or c1-c0 != len(motif[0]):
            continue
        for dr in range(len(motif)):
            out[r0+dr][c0:c1] = motif[dr][:]
    return out
PY
